channel.title: South Africa - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Africa, every source cited.

item.title: Lesufi and Zille trade barbs over Joburg service delivery
item.description: Gauteng Premier Panyaza Lesufi and DA mayoral candidate Helen Zille exchanged insults ahead of local elections.

item.title: South Africans debate realistic SASSA grant increase
item.description: Some citizens favour a smaller, achievable rise in the old-age grant over larger, unmet promises.

item.title: South Africa reach 140/4 against Australia
item.description: Proteas hold a 40-run lead after Australia were bowled out for 429 in the third Test in Cape Town.

item.title: Cape Town terminal expects 13% fruit export rise
item.description: South Africa's deciduous fruit exports, including grapes and stone fruit, face new delivery rules for the upcoming season.

item.title: Stellenbosch mother dies after son killed in crash
item.description: Gaynor Adams, 38, died in hospital five days after her six-year-old son died at the scene of a crash on Helshoogte Pass.
